_comment: Visual index of the unidentified gallery photographs. Built by opening each file and recording only what is actually visible in frame. `fixture` is set ONLY where a document in the photograph names the fixture (programme crests, team sheet). `venue`/`club` are set where the ground is identifiable. `confidence: venue` means the photo proves the ground but NOT which match, so any caption must describe the ground, not the game.
